jd_text:
Frontend Developer (Junior) - Ahmedabad, On-site
Product Engineering | Full time

About us
We build a scheduling and billing product used by around 4,000 clinics across India. The
frontend team is five people. You will sit with them, not with a services pod, and you will
own screens end to end rather than picking up tickets someone else specced.

What you will do
- Build and maintain features in our React application, from the API contract through to
  the shipped screen
- Turn Figma designs into responsive components that hold up on mid-range Android phones,
  which is what most of our users have
- Work with the backend team on API shape before it is built, not after
- Write component tests and keep the existing ones green
- Take part in code review, both giving and receiving

What we are looking for
- 1 to 2 years of experience building React applications that real users have used. A
  strong internship plus serious side projects can count for this, tell us in the cover note
- Comfortable with modern JavaScript: promises, async/await, array methods, modules
- React fundamentals you can explain, not just use: state, props, hooks, the render cycle,
  when a component re-renders and why
- CSS that you write deliberately. We use Tailwind, but we care more that you understand
  flexbox, grid and the box model than that you have used Tailwind before
- Git in a team setting: branches, pull requests, resolving your own conflicts
- REST API integration, and some sense of what to do when a request fails

Nice to have
- TypeScript. We are migrating and new code is written in it, so you will learn it here if
  you have not used it
- Redux Toolkit or another state library beyond Context
- Testing with Jest and React Testing Library
- Next.js. Our marketing site runs on it
- Some exposure to accessibility, or a willingness to be taught it seriously
- Experience with a component library such as Radix or MUI

Interview process
A 45 minute call, a take-home you have three days for, then a pairing session on your own
take-home code with two of the team. We do not do whiteboard algorithm rounds.

Compensation
6 to 9 LPA depending on what you show us. On-site in Ahmedabad, five days, near SG Highway.
